summary:
Failed (assertion) on step 9: The hosting-side email/inbox service appears to have hit its storage quota or mailbox limit, causing message creation/delivery to fail. Because the inbox is full, the scripted office conversation is never persisted, so the All view remains empty and the message body cannot be verified. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

The Inbox shows a mailbox-capacity warning, and the scripted office conversation did not appear. Its message body could not be verified.
